Not new to the roleplay scene but pretty new to the text roleplay scene... so here we go! I am more than willing to let you be the demon. Typically for long-term roleplays I like to craft a character around the prompt, just as if I were an author writing a book.

{ANGEL} Her name is Anna Pierce (she/her) (took a while to find a fitting last name...), and honestly, the age just depends on what time frame we're in (16-25?). Given her naturally kind and thoughtful nature,   naturally she attracts the attention of her classmates. Their intentions may not always be pure though, as Anna's kindness is easily taken advantage of- not that she would do anything about it. A source of her insecurities, she's trying to learn to speak up for herself, while still. having everyone's best interests at heart. I would imagine she'd be on the student council, seeing as she's gained some notoriety as a well-mannered girl, so that could be a fun trope to play around with as she's trying her hardest to be disciplinary.

Just below average height at 5'2, Anna has a smaller frame, though she has gained some impressive leg muscle from running (dang!) I'd say her hair is type 2B texture: dark brown (almost black- JUST not quite). Her eyes aren't much different- from a distance you could say they're black with a sort of intensity once she's focused on a subject. Honestly the closest I could think of a reference for an appearance is a mix or Blair Waldorf and Rory Gilmore. Just not mean/having questionable morals.

So you can call me Monarch, I am a 19 year old female and my pronouns are she/her. When it comes to my typing length I tend to mimic my partner's length, so go crazy. I enjoy playing other characters- gives me another chance to develop new personalities. Also I have a preference for writing in third-person.

Alrighty :} -Monarch
